intro.en: AICC is the internal consulting and innovation lab of the Bank for the adoption of artificial intelligence. This page is the summary of AICC: what it is, its goal, its strategy, its approach, its authority, and its safeguards. Each part points to the page that holds the detail.
This section describes the services that AICC offers to the functions of the Bank, the Solutions that it delivers, and the way a function engages AICC.
intro.ru: Раздел описывает услуги, которые AICC предоставляет функциям Банка, решения, которые он создаёт, и порядок обращения функции в AICC.

intro.en: This section states the method of AICC: how Initiatives are taken in and decided, how Solutions are delivered, released, and operated, how the work is paced, and how it is measured. The workflows show the flow, and the guides explain it.
intro.ru: Раздел излагает метод AICC: как принимаются и решаются инициативы, как создаются, выпускаются и эксплуатируются решения, как организован ритм работы и как она измеряется. Процессы показывают ход работы, руководства поясняют его.

intro.en: This section states the Roles of AICC, the levels at which decisions are taken, and the bodies that advise and decide. The people who hold the Roles are named in the Appointments Record of the Registry, and the charter names Roles only.
intro.ru: Раздел излагает роли AICC, уровни принятия решений и органы, которые консультируют и решают. Лица, исполняющие роли, названы в Журнале назначений Реестра; устав называет только роли.

intro.en: This section states the rules for the use of AI at the Bank: the Risk Tiers, the checks and validations before use, the review of providers, the handling of AI Incidents, and the Exceptions. It links to the AI Risk Appetite Statement and to the gates of delivery.
intro.ru: Раздел излагает правила использования ИИ в Банке: уровни риска, проверки и валидацию перед использованием, оценку поставщиков, обработку инцидентов ИИ и исключения. В нём есть ссылки на Заявление о риск-аппетите ИИ и на контрольные точки поставки.

intro.en: This section states how AICC is controlled, reported, and assured: the control loops, the records and the evidence, the catalogue of controls, and the reporting to the Board Committee. The status of each control at a date is kept in the Control Matrix of the Registry.
intro.ru: Раздел излагает, как осуществляются контроль, отчётность и обеспечение уверенности в AICC: контуры контроля, записи и свидетельства, каталог контролей и отчётность перед комитетом совета. Статус каждого контроля на дату ведётся в Матрице контролей Реестра.

intro.en: This section holds the thirteen templates, the forms of the records that AICC produces. A template gives the form, and the rules for the record are in the documents.
intro.ru: Раздел содержит тринадцать шаблонов: формы записей, которые ведёт AICC. Шаблон задаёт форму, а правила ведения записи изложены в документах.

intro.en: This section holds the Vocabulary, the Document Catalog, the change history of the documents, and the page that states where each record is kept.
intro.ru: Раздел содержит Словарь, Каталог документов, историю изменений документов и страницу, которая указывает, где хранится каждая запись.

text.en: AICC is an internal consulting and innovation lab of the Bank. It explores, trials, and proves the use of AI with the functions, delivers the outcome, and proposes what the Bank should adopt at scale. It works as a consulting unit does: it engages with a function on a defined scope, delivers an outcome with its evidence, and keeps its commitments and its records in order.

The mission of AICC is to enable the Bank to adopt AI as a governed capability that delivers measured value. The adoption improves the quality, speed, and consistency of the operations and services of the Bank, and supports its mission to improve people's lives with digital products and services. Accountability for every Solution stays with a named individual, and controls stay proportionate to risk.
The Bank pursues seven Strategic Priorities, in order, and advances each through five Maturity Levels. A Maturity Level is reached for a Strategic Priority when its Measures are met.

A function brings a need to AICC. AICC takes it in as an Initiative, tries it first as a minimum viable product, measures it against defined success Measures, and extends it only on that evidence. The work runs on a common cadence, is made visible, and is limited in progress. Before a Solution reaches its users, it is checked or validated by a person other than its builder, accepted by the Team, and accepted by the Domain Owner who asked for it.

AICC acts under the mandate of the Executive Sponsor, whom the Board names. It does not own or operate the AI Platform, own the business results of a Domain, set the rules of a Control Function, or validate its own work. The Control Functions stay independent and may stop a Solution, and internal audit gives assurance only. The AICC Lead reports each quarter, and the Board oversees AI through the Board Committee.

Each Solution is assigned a Risk Tier, which sets the review, validation, human oversight, and speed of release that apply to it. The Bank accepts risk from AI where the benefit is measured and the controls are proportionate, and it does not accept a breach of law or regulation.
Three values guide the work: integrity, prudence, and respect for people. The principles of adoption, application, work, and delivery follow from them.
